diagnosis.meaning: At least one public JSON-RPC provider returned an eth_getLogs row that did not satisfy the exact requested indexed-topic filter. Treating that response as authoritative would contaminate the frozen USDC burn event set.

transport_correction.response_policy: Before accepting a provider response, verify every returned row against the exact requested contract address and every non-null topic position. A mismatch is a provider failure and must fall through to the next provider. Successful result=[] alone is an empty interval. All-provider failure remains fail-closed.
